businessProblem: Future Retail Ltd. faces active IBC insolvency petition from Bank of India, ₹5,322.32 crore in bank dues, a failed Reliance asset-sale transaction blocked by Amazon legal dispute and creditor resistance. No alternative rescue plan exists. Diagnose root causes and recommend highest-priority action plan.

evidence.finding: Future Retail owes banks ₹5,322.32 crore as of 31 March 2022 per Bank of India NCLT petition
evidence.source: Bank of India NCLT petition, IBC case records

evidence.finding: Bank of India filed IBC Section 7 petition before NCLT Mumbai for non-payment of dues
Liquidity stress severe — company unable to service bank obligations as they fell due
Proposed Reliance transaction could not be implemented after secured creditors voted against the scheme
evidence.source: Creditor vote outcome and public reporting

evidence.finding: Future Retail warned in 2020 that if Reliance deal failed, liquidation risk existed — deal is now effectively blocked
No identified alternative strategic buyer or rescue transaction as of decision date
evidence.source: Public reporting and absence of credible alternative announcement

evidence.finding: Amazon arbitration dispute entangled and effectively blocked the Future-Reliance asset sale transaction
Secured creditors voted against the rescue scheme, removing the primary restructuring pathway

clientContext.primaryStakeholder: Board of Directors and creditor committee

ownerConstraintProfile.managementCapability: LOW — leadership credibility undermined by failed transaction and debt default
ownerConstraintProfile.accountabilityWeakness: HIGH — creditor standstill not achieved, no fallback plan visible
